name: roamr-monorepo
description: ROAMR — Explore, Quest, Earn. Expo React Native mobile app + Express backend for PayPal AI Hackathon.

scripts.dev: npm run usb:reverse && concurrently -n SERVER,APP -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix app run start"
scripts.start: npm run usb:reverse && concurrently -n SERVER,APP -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix app run start"
scripts.app: npm run usb:reverse && npm --prefix app run start
scripts.usb:reverse: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$adb = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\Genymobile.scrcpy_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\scrcpy-win64-v5.0.1\adb.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $adb)) { $adb = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe' }; if (Test-Path $adb) { & $adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 2>$null; & $adb reverse tcp:5000 tcp:5000 2>$null }; exit 0"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix app install
